text: TechGnomo V1 is live. The workshop is open.
ClearMoneyPath is coming in 3 weeks. A pay-cycle planner. Not on a store, and not for sale.

We fixed a bug today that was apparently convinced rent should be paid twice. It has been dealt with. Bills were being counted twice when reserving money. Each bill’s pro-rata share is now reserved once.
The coming-soon page is up on techgnomo.com. The countdown runs to Monday, 9:00 am Brisbane.
The old portfolio and the old TechGnomo OS are retired. The public site stays on the countdown until Monday.
